title: Italy photo license verification — batch 02
scope: The second 20 previously unverified Italy image records, in original manifest order. Counts below describe the currently selected files after replacement.
method: Compared each exact Commons page with the manifest for file identity, subject, creator/uploader, license version, attribution notes, and separate restrictions. Two exact original pages remained unresolved and were replaced. Each current selected page was source checked. Eight replacement WebPs were visually inspected after conversion.
findings: Six original pages resolved but had a separate restriction, conflicting license provenance, or material subject-description mismatch; two original pages remained unresolved. These eight images were replaced.

Three Puglia Commons pages displayed an additional Italian cultural-heritage notice requiring separate authorization for commercial reproduction. Replacement pages were checked and did not display that notice; no claim is made that the Commons grants were invalid.

The previous Herculaneum Delso page states CC BY-SA 4.0 and separately says the file may not be uploaded to Facebook. Since this guide emits og:image metadata for link previews, another image was selected for this distribution path. This is not a finding that the CC license was invalid or revoked. The creator asked for an email if used outside Commons; none was sent.

The old Cala Goloritzé page had conflicting license provenance: a Flickr review accepted CC BY 2.0 while the earlier CC BY-SA 2.0 upload claim remained and the page expressed uncertainty about its validity.
The Siena Commons page requests the visible credit “© José Luiz Bernardes Ribeiro.” That full name is shown in the site credit. The photographer’s separate email request was not acted on.
The Budelli author asks for a beside-image credit, a link to the source, and an email notice. The visible credit sits by the image and links to Commons and the license; no email was sent.

Tropea remains flagged: the Commons uploader is “Luigino” while the description says “Luigino C.” The underlying person is not established. It is source-page checked but excluded from fully attribution-cleared counts.
A Commons license display does not independently establish the uploader’s underlying rights chain.
